title: An oxide-promoted, self-supported Ni4Mo catalyst for high current density anion exchange membrane water electrolysis
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE04528A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ariana Serban, Meng-Ting Liu, Nanjun Chen, Hao Ming Chen, Xile Hu
A highly efficient Ni4Mo–MoOx catalyst enables anionic exchange membrane (AEM) water electrolyzers to operate at 3 A cm−2 with a voltage of only about 2 V.
